content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms often impose high fees and geographic restrictions, making it difficult for creators in varying regions to monetize their work. For instance, services like Gumroad charge 10% on every sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, allowing you to retain more revenue. This infrastructure empowers you to take ownership of your sales without the risk of platform lock-in, ensuring your financial autonomy.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential tools. Start with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free web hosting. Next, you require a backend solution such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage payment logic. For order storage, Supabase or Google Sheets will suffice. Lastly, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This combination forms a cohesive stack that enables automated delivery and seamless payment processing.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your tools are in place, configure NOWPayments to handle transactions. With support for over 300 cryptocurrencies, it allows you to price your products in USD and convert at the time of transaction, minimizing volatility risk. Automate delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their digital products immediately upon successful payment. This streamlined process enhances customer satisfaction and reduces manual workload.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, keeping more profit in your pocket.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting everything up, it’s time to go live. Publish your site and test the purchasing process to ensure everything functions smoothly. Start by processing a small transaction to verify that payments and product delivery work as intended. This initial test will help identify any potential issues before you fully launch. Once confirmed, you can begin marketing your products and building your customer base.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your digital storefront, scaling becomes the next priority. Monitor your sales performance and customer feedback to refine your offerings. Consider expanding your product range or utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for additional templates and blueprints that facilitate growth. With a solid infrastructure, you can confidently increase your sales volume without the fear of unexpected fees or restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a self-hosted solution that leverages cryptocurrency for payments. By implementing NOWPayments with a custom digital storefront, you ensure low fees and complete control over your sales. This setup enables you to sell your products directly to customers without relying on traditional platforms.
Own your digital store without the risk of platform lock-in.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate cryptocurrency payments into my store?

You can integrate cryptocurrency payments by setting up NOWPayments, which allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. Follow the integration guide included in the Complete Builder Kit to ensure your payment processing is seamless and efficient.
What platforms can I use for hosting my digital products?

For hosting, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which offer free hosting solutions. These platforms are ideal for serving your digital products without incurring additional costs, allowing you to focus on sales.
Can I automate the delivery of my digital products?

Yes, you can automate delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Set up your backend logic to trigger product delivery immediately after payment confirmation, ensuring customers receive their purchases without delay.
Is there a way to avoid high platform fees?

Absolutely. By utilizing NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, you can significantly reduce transaction fees compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This approach maximizes your revenue on each sale.
What type of digital products can I sell?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The infrastructure we discuss supports various formats, enabling you to reach diverse audiences.
